author: M. R. Nola

Zippa's tip: bring a spare pair of socks. Always.
Challenge: do 5 keepy-uppies before the next page!
Fun fact: the classic football design has 32 panels.
Zippa says: you're allowed to be proud of yourself today.
Warning: this page may cause giggling.
Zippa says: nobody wins on their own.
Challenge: high-five someone before you turn the page.

pad_pages.text: Zippa wants a new pair of boots. Design them, then give them a name that sounds like a superhero.
pad_pages.line: Superhero boots: strong, fast, a little bit shiny.

pad_pages.text: Zippa the ball has been kicked all the way to the moon. Write the next three sentences of the story.
pad_pages.line: Moon football has bounce for days.

pad_pages.text: Plan a tricky free kick! Draw the wall of players, the ball's path, and where it ends up.
pad_pages.line: Bendy shots are the best shots.

cover.back_description:
Calling all girls who love football! Meet Zippa, your ball-shaped coach, who is here to cheer you on all season.

Inside you'll find:
- 30+ prompts that make you think, draw, rank and invent (design a trophy, make up a rule, pick your dream five-a-side)
- Directed doodle challenges with a starting sketch already on the page
- Post-match player reports, a Match Diary, and a Training Log
- 8 word searches (each with a hidden secret word) and 8 mazes with stars to collect
- Answers at the back, because even legends peek

Big friendly writing lines for ages 6-10. A brilliant birthday or end-of-season gift!

items.text: You've just been made manager for one whole day. Your first rule: everybody must do one silly thing before kick-off. What is the silly thing, and who has to do it first?
items.line: Warm-up rule number one: laugh a lot.

items.text: Would you rather...
items.line: Both are brilliant. One is more brilliant. Choose wisely!
options: Score the winning goal, but nobody sees it happen
Score a scrappy goal in front of 50,000 cheering fans

items.text: Design the boots that make you run 10% faster. Add three secret features and label each one with an arrow.
items.line: Fast boots need a fast name. Think big.

sections.line: Warm legs, warm hearts, cold orange slices.

puzzles.title: Kick-Off Warm-Up
puzzles.blurb: Warm-up time! Find all 12 words on the list. Careful: one sneaky extra word is hiding too.

secret.clue: What you do to your legs before a match so they don't go ouch (7 letters).

sections.line: Easy peasy. Don't get too cocky.
blurbs: Follow the tunnel out to the pitch! Collect all 3 stars on the way.

items.text: Your football comes alive when everyone has gone home. Draw what it gets up to at night.
items.line: Shhh. The ball is having a party.

items.text: Rank these match-day moments from best to worst: orange slices at half time, muddy knees, the team huddle, a brand new kit, the final whistle.
items.line: Whatever you pick, muddy knees are undefeated.
Take a bow. Even if you lost, you showed up. That's the first win.

sections.title: Match Diary
sections.line: Write it down now. Future you will want to remember.

items.text: The referee blows the whistle to start the match, and then every player's boots suddenly turn bright pink. Nobody knows why. You are the only one who does...
items.line: Plot twist loading. Write fast!

items.text: The ball is about to pass through this goal. Draw the goalkeeper's most ridiculous dive ever.
items.line: Extra points for a flying hat.

sections.line: Chewing is not allowed during the whistle.

puzzles.title: Half-Time Snacks
puzzles.blurb: Refuel! Find 13 snacks. One extra word is hiding that isn't on the list.

secret.clue: What snacks give you for the second half (6 letters).

sections.line: Cones hate being hit. Be nice.
blurbs: Dribble past the cones! Pick up 3 stars to power up your boots.

items.text: Fill in every gap with your own words, then draw the scene in the box!
items.line: Fill the gaps, then draw the scene below!
options: On match day I wake up feeling ______. I pack my ______ and my lucky ______. When I step onto the pitch, I hear ______ and I think, 'Today I am going to ______!'

items.text: Pick the loudest noise in football: the final whistle, the crowd roaring, the ball hitting the crossbar, or your friends yelling your name. Which one makes your tummy flip, and why?
items.line: Crossbar clang: honourable mention.

items.text: Rank these jobs on a football team from 'I'd love to do this' to 'No thank you': goalkeeper, captain, kit manager, referee, mascot in a giant costume.
items.line: The kit manager secretly runs everything.

items.text: Zippa needs a goalkeeper! Draw one who is half octopus, half human, and add every arm saving a shot.
items.line: Eight arms. Zero excuses.

items.text: Would you rather...
items.line: Zippa would pick the bouncy ball. Zippa is biased.
options: Have a football that always bounces back to you
Have boots that let you jump twice as high

items.text: Design your perfect team kit, front and back. Add a number, a pattern and one detail that makes you laugh.
items.line: Stripes make you 3% faster. Probably.
items.caption: Our team is called:

items.title: Skills Check: Kick-Off
items.line: Be honest. A 2 today can be a 5 by the end.

sections.title: Training Log
sections.line: Even ten minutes counts. Honest.

items.text: Your team needs a badge! Design one that scares the other team a tiny bit but also makes them smile.
items.line: Badges look best with a tiny animal on them. Just saying.

items.text: Invent a brand-new football skill. Draw it in the box, give it a name, and say how hard it is to learn.
items.line: Skill names with 'twist' in them always sound cool.

items.text: Make up one new rule that would make football even more fun. No rule can involve hurting anyone.
items.line: If it involves silly hats, it's probably brilliant.
labels: What happens if you break it

sections.line: Skills are just practice wearing a cape.

puzzles.title: Super Skills
puzzles.blurb: Skills time! 14 moves to find. Think you can spot the secret one?

secret.clue: The real secret behind every skill: do it again and again (8 letters).

sections.line: Mud is just chocolate for boots.
blurbs: Squelch! Find a way across the muddy middle and grab 4 stars.

items.text: Would you rather...
items.line: No wrong answers. Only funny ones.
options: Play on a pitch made of jelly for one whole match
Play a match where the ball is the size of a beach ball

items.text: Your team is losing 2-0 with five minutes left. The coach whispers a secret plan in your ear. What is it, and what happens next?
items.line: Five minutes is a LONG time in football.

items.text: It's the stadium of the year 2090. Add floodlights, a roof, and one thing no stadium has today.
items.line: Flying hot-dog vans are allowed.

items.title: Training Log
items.line: Hard days count double. Write them down too.

sections.line: Pack your boots. Pack your passport.

puzzles.title: Around the World
puzzles.blurb: Football travels the globe! Find 15 countries. One extra word is hiding.

secret.clue: Football is played all over this (6 letters).

sections.line: The corner flag is waiting.
blurbs: Sprint down the wing to the corner flag! Collect 4 stars before you get there.

items.text: You're picking a five-a-side team from anybody you know: friends, family, teachers, pets. Put your choices in order, starting with who plays in goal.
items.line: Your goalkeeper had better be brave. Or fluffy.

items.text: The ball is stuck in a tree and it's the last ball you have. Do you climb, get a grown-up, or invent a machine? Describe your brilliant plan step by step.
items.line: Machines with a button are always the best answer.
You faced a tricky match and you kept going. That's what a real player does.

sections.line: Look closely. Mud hides in plain sight.

puzzles.title: Pitch Life
puzzles.blurb: Everything you see on matchday! Find all 16 words, then crack the secret one.

secret.clue: The noisy, buzzy feeling when the stands are full (10 letters).

sections.line: Defenders are sneaky. Be sneakier.
blurbs: Dodge the defenders (the dead ends!) and collect 5 stars on the way to goal.

sections.title: Match Diary
sections.line: Did you do something amazing? Write it before you forget.

items.text: Draw the official team bus. Give it a slogan, a flag, and one very silly feature.
items.line: The bus is the real star of the tournament.
items.caption: Our bus slogan is:

items.text: Finish the story of the best goal you ever saw, then sketch the moment!
items.line: Every great goal story has a wobbly bit in the middle.
options: The best goal I ever saw was scored by ______. It went in off the ______ and everybody ______. The crowd shouted '______!' and I felt ______.

items.text: You're the new keeper. A shot is coming straight at you. In the next five seconds, anything could happen. Tell the whole story, second by second.
items.line: Slow motion makes everything more dramatic.

items.text: Your team has won a trip anywhere in the world to play one match. Where do you go, who sits next to you on the bus, and what snack do you pack?
items.line: Window seat negotiations begin now.

items.text: You find a golden football boot buried in the school field. When you put it on, something amazing happens on the pitch. What is it?
items.line: Golden boots always have a catch.

items.text: Invent a goal celebration that the whole team can do together. It needs a name and at least three moves.
items.line: Cartwheels are allowed. Backflips are not.
Look at you, showing up again. Zippa is doing a victory dance for you.

items.text: Draw a four-panel comic about the funniest thing that ever happened at football.
items.line: Great comics always end with a surprise.
items.caption: My comic is called:

items.text: Design a mascot for your team, real or invented. Draw it, name it, and give it a half-time trick.
items.line: Mascots can do cartwheels. Mine cannot. Yet.

items.text: Zippa's scoreboard has gone wrong! Fill it in with the silliest match result and the team names.
items.line: If the score is 99-98, I want to see the highlights.
items.caption: Man of the match was:

items.text: Finish the newspaper headline and story, then sketch the front-page photo.
items.line: Journalists love a dramatic adjective.
options: BREAKING NEWS: ______ SCORES ______ IN THE LAST ______ SECONDS AS FANS ______!

items.text: Draw the view from the very top of the stadium: the pitch, the crowd, the sky, and one surprising thing flying past.
items.line: Pigeons have the best seats.
items.caption: The surprising thing is:

items.line: You've played lots of matches now. That's real experience, champion.

sections.title: Training Log
sections.line: Hard days count double. Write them down too.
Quiet teams lose. Loud teams giggle.

puzzles.title: Team Chat
puzzles.blurb: Great teams talk! Find 17 words players shout on the pitch. Spot the secret word that every team needs.

secret.clue: What makes ordinary players unstoppable (8 letters).

sections.line: No lifts. Only legs.
blurbs: Up the stairs, round the corners! Collect 5 stars before the match starts.

items.text: Design the ultimate trophy for a tournament only your friends play in. Draw it, name it, and say what you win.
items.line: Sticker prizes are valid prizes.

items.text: Invent a ceremony for the end of every match: what does the winning team do, and what does the losing team do? Both have to be fun!
items.line: Good ceremonies include a dance.

items.text: Rank the most important things a team needs: a good goalkeeper, a loud captain, a funny joker, a speedy winger, and a kind encourager. Who matters most? Explain with a score of 1 to 5.
items.line: Plot twist: everybody matters most.

sections.line: Dramatic music plays in the distance.

puzzles.title: Match Drama
puzzles.blurb: Drama time! Find all 18 big-moment words. The secret word is what happens when you turn it all around.

secret.clue: When you're losing and then win anyway (8 letters).

sections.line: Quick feet. Quicker brain.
blurbs: Fast break! Race across the pitch and collect 6 stars before the defenders recover.

items.text: Plan your dream training session with the equipment in the picture. Draw the drills, the cones, and add one new piece of kit.
items.line: Drills are better when there's music.
items.caption: My training session is called:

items.text: You've been asked to give a pep talk to a younger player who is scared before their first match. What three things do you say? Write the real words.
items.line: Real talk. Real power.

items.text: Would you rather...
items.line: Hmmm. Hard one. Take your time.
options: Win every match by one goal and never get the credit
Lose every match by one goal but be the funniest team ever

items.title: Match Diary
items.line: Last diary pages. Make them count.

sections.line: You've come a long way. Look at that grid!

puzzles.title: Champion Mindset
puzzles.blurb: The final puzzle! Find all 20 champion words. The secret word is what people call you when you never give up.

secret.clue: What people call you when you never give up (6 letters).

sections.line: You can do hard things. This is one of them.
blurbs: The last maze! 7 stars to collect and the finish line is waiting.

items.text: Somebody says girls shouldn't play football. Write the reply that would make the whole room clap.
items.line: Mic drop. Optional. Very satisfying.

items.text: Design a brand-new ball that does something amazing: glows, bounces extra high, plays music... Draw it and label every feature.
items.line: Zippa is very jealous of this ball.
items.caption: Name of the ball:

items.text: Rank what makes a great game: a nail-biting finish, lots of goals, brilliant teamwork, perfect weather, a loud crowd. Which one matters most to you?
items.line: Plot twist: puddles make it better.

items.text: The final whistle has blown and the score is level. A mysterious door opens in the centre circle. What's inside?
items.line: Doors that appear on pitches are always suspicious.

items.text: Plan a surprise party for the team on the pitch. Draw the cake, the banners, and who jumps out of the goal.
items.line: Party hats are shin-pad compatible.
items.caption: The party is called:

items.text: Would you rather...
items.line: Zippa can't decide. Help!
options: Be the fastest runner in the world
Be the best passer in the world

items.text: Draw the trophy cabinet of your future self. What have you won, and where is each trophy from?
items.line: Stay humble. Trophies are shiny, though.
You powered through extra time. Zippa has run out of confetti.

items.title: Skills Check: Full Time
items.line: Compare this with your Kick-Off scores. Look how far you've come!
Season finished! You showed up, tried hard and cheered for others. Champion move.

items.text: Design your hall-of-fame banner! Draw yourself lifting a trophy, with three things you're proudest of around the edges.
items.line: Banners go better with glitter. Imagine glitter.
items.caption: My hall-of-fame title:

items.text: Write your acceptance speech for winning the 'Most Brilliant Player of All Time' award. Who do you thank? What are you going to say to the crowd?
items.line: Tears optional. Giggles encouraged.

items.text: Look back through this book. What are you proudest of, and what is the next challenge you want to try? Write your goal and the first small step.
items.line: You're a champion. Write it down!
